label: Sparse: input t/1/k at final copy steps of short sequences
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.045% of steps). About 73% of mass is in the copy phase, mostly at the last two outputs (to_go<=1, recall_idx 2-3) of short sequences (L=3-4). Input tokens t, 1 and k are heavily enriched (12x, 7x, 3.5x), and outputting 1 is enriched 17x. The strongest examples are X 1 1 <DEL> X [1] and .. t 1 <DEL> .. [t], i.e. emitting a final 1 after input 1 or t. About 25% of mass is in the original phase at steps 2-4 with no clear token rule, e.g. after i or before 0. Any coherent predicate has very low precision: most steps matching the token/position conditions are inactive. A narrow conjunction (input t/1, output in {1,x,o,z,e}, L<=4, to_go<=1) reaches only F1 0.32. Magnitude is highest for a final output of 1 in L=3 sequences. Never fires at t=0-1, and almost never late in long sequences.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=8: t, k, 1, v; t=7: t, 1, k, v; t=6: t, 1, k, v) and the token being output (most: 1, o, z, x, e, q; least: r, d, i, b); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, L=3 & t=5, t=4.
